summary: HydroGeoIA Lab software suite for image-based river velocimetry and surface-flow analysis from videos and aerial imagery. It integrates PIV, optical flow, FFPTV and STIV workflows, metric calibration, dense velocity-vector visualization, method comparison and export of results for river and channel monitoring. For: Bastián A. Rivas Maldonado
name: RiverVision Image Velocimetry Suite

summary: This toolbox allows users to characterize and classify River Styles based on hydromorphological metrics extracted at segment scale, implementing a semi-automatic approach that no longer relies on subjective expert judgment. As a result of the analysis, 43 Rivers Styles have been classified and characterized using the SRT.
name: South rivers Toolbox

summary: We developed an advanced monitoring system using remote sensing technology. Through satellite images, hyperspectral spectroscopy and bio-optical models, we were able to assess and monitor water quality in four strategic lakes in south-central Chile: Laguna Grande de San Pedro de la Paz, Lago Lanalhue, Lago Villarrica and Lago Llanquihue.
name: Water Quality Monitoring Platform
